failure_patterns: Sentence-level bge (dense) rescue has low precision. On dev, 3 of 94 rescued sessions are gold; on dev200, 1 of 30. The rescued sentences are generic first-person chatter ('I'm looking for some advice on how to organize my closet'), and their sentence-CE scores (-6 to -11.3) overlap the gold rescues (-8.8 to -10.7), so a CE gate cannot separate them.

Test histories plant decoys exactly where a rescue looks. Even the strict lexical+fact rescue (lf) adds 'one-off watercolour workshop' (q_6dd9e5e4fb97, weekly classes), 'bought a 12-volt dial lamp for the R-77' (q_6834eb0349a2, tubes replaced) and 'repotted two orchids' (q_47e3f2749c07, orchids added). The only good catches are the bakery deposit of 25,000 pesos (q_bcd6d210710b) and, with r2m only, the round-2 target 'finished reading a book about the history of Sao Paulo' (q_8b4f1ff8ce11).

The remaining dev/dev200 PA losses are now within-session unit choice, not session recall. With g2m the health-devices question gets its hearing-aid session (SR 1.0, ATR 0.83) but misses the 'replacement batteries for my hearing aids' turn. The properties question gets the condo session, but dense scoring picks 'I'm looking at options for condo' over 'I viewed a 1-bedroom condo on February 10th'.

No evidence-based multi_like signal for an ssu->multi hand-off. On the 98 dev ssu-routed questions, the gap between the top-1 and top-3 sessions by best own sentence overlaps completely (median: gold ssu 0.164, gold multi 0.126, gold ku 0.179) and so does the top cosine. No 0-FP threshold catches any of the 3 failing multi->ssu questions.

The abstention term shifts on test-style histories. Shorter, chattier sentences give a lower s_top, so 5 of 20 test multi packs reach abstain_p >= 0.5. Only feijoada (0.87) is plausibly unanswerable. Pooled routed precision at 0.6 is 10/23, still below the policy bar.
core_requests: Add a sentence-keyed instance index, hx.sentences, with own / declarative / negated / reported-speech flags and cached CE, plus an instance-aware sentence scorer (CE on question-as-statement vs sentence, batched). bge-small cosine on sentences is too topical to drive a rescue.

Report an ATR_any metric (at least one gold turn per gold session) next to PA for multi. PA requires every gold turn and undercounts packs Reactor can likely answer (health devices, properties under g2m).

failure_patterns: How the numbers above are scoped: dev/dev200 are gold-ssa questions sent through the router. v1 scores 91.8 / 93.7 there. The chars field is the comb variant; comb_guard_adv chars were not broken out per type. Whole routed system: dev 85.9 -> 86.2 (Sall 84.7 -> 85.0, AUC 0.810 -> 0.811), dev200 tie at 84.9 / 83.2. That is below the +2 S bar. Test: 0 of 90 ssu/multi/ssa packs change (harness.audit --compare runs/final/v1_test_packs.jsonl); ku and temporal are untouched by construction.

Main failure, visible to Reactor but not to the proxy metric: an ssa question routed to ssu keeps the right pack (PA=1, S~94) but gets the ssu ownership hint 'Answer from what the user said about their own X ... not the answer'. In real-Reactor calibration this made q_73a1f68b2421 ('Which company does a great job with environmentally responsible supply chains?', gold Patagonia, already in the pack) return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. All 13 gold-ssa dev questions left on the ssu route carry this hint. Other examples: 'Which beer goes in the Seco de Cordero from Ancash?' and 'Which traditional game ... at powwows?'. The new hint guard covers these on dev; nothing on test is affected.

The cross-encoder role margin fails when the answer echoes the user's words or comes from the user. 'Besides sexual compulsions, what were the other four alternative terms?' has d=-0.3; A's lexical scan sees it (pA 0.87) and the combined score catches it. 'President's Chief Advisor ... in the article' has d=-5.0 because the user pasted the article; it stays at S 28.7. 'Which show was my example of Netflix' (temporal route) has d=-8.9 and v1 already answers it (S 91.9).

Thin margin at the nearest ssu question: 'How long did it take to move to the new apartment?' has no first-person word and the highest negative score (combined z 0.85 on dev, 0.65 on dev200, switch threshold 1.39). It therefore gets only the hint guard (it loses the ownership sentence and keeps its pack), not a lens switch. Lens A's round-2 variant s55 switched it and lost on dev200.

Temporal-route hand-off (brief item 2) is not feasible: dev has 1 gold-ssa question on that route (user-role) and dev200 has 0, while 7 dev / 2 dev200 temporal questions score p >= 0.8 ('Which trip did the narrator take first'). Not built.

The ssa type itself is saturated: v1 a_recsent r2_conf2 scores 93.6 / 93.7 with PA=CF1=1. Test ssa packs are 2.4-3.2k chars, single session, and 23/25 quote the recommendation line. The two without a quote are Lisbon coworking (pack holds 'Heden in Baixa has a good day pass', no 'coworking' word) and speedwork coach (pack holds 'Coach Miriam'). No trimming, per the brief.

failure_patterns: Whole-question route (no parsed events): the gold sets list every same-category session, and some sit 6-17 CE logits below the anchor session, so they never enter the pack (ALL=0). Examples: 'Who did I go with to the music event last Saturday?' (dev200, gold has 5 Saturday sessions; s_88e91b1b31f3 is outside the pack), 'sports event two weeks ago' (s_954e7ec708ab missing), 'life event of a relative a week ago' (wedding session 05/06 missing). No score floor or session cap separates them from decoys: keeping 98/109 gold sessions also keeps 266/392 non-gold ones. The cite-rule grid is flat at CF1 about 0.64.

Gold turn sits in a non-cited category-mate session and is not that session's best unit. Example: '5 days ago social media activity', where the gold turn is '#FoodieAdventures yesterday' in the 03/10 session. Heads over the top 6 sessions fix some of these; heads over 8 sessions use up the budget and ALL drops.

Order questions: the second gold turn is a paraphrase in a later turn of the session, with CE -7 to -11 against the event phrase. Examples: 'upgraded my home Wi-Fi router 3 weeks ago' for 'the mesh network system', and 'Galapagos as a solo traveler' for 'solo trip to Thailand'. In Page Turners / Marketing Professionals, a third gold session holding another mention is never retrieved by A's 2-session pack.

Run-to-run noise of about ±0.5 S on dev with identical code. Example: 'Who became a parent first, Rachel or Alex?' flips to PA 0 in one full run and scores PA 1 when run alone. So differences under 1 S are not meaningful.

Agreement fallback pitfall: on A's rounding gate (weeks) and on the test sourdough question (sign gate, raw 58), B 'agrees' with A because both computations use the same arithmetic or the same garbage picks. The fallback is therefore restricted to gate None.
